  ## Test results
  
  The isolated copies are in `/tmp/railsup/work/`. They used their own PostgreSQL 15 on port 55432, Redis on port 63799 with no persistence, and gems in `/tmp/railsup/bundle`. Storage and cache files stayed inside each copy. The shared services on ports 5432 and 6379 were not touched.

  | 8.1.0 with the same changes | 4 failures and 40 errors, caused by json 3.0.2 [E] |
  | 8.1.0 with `gem "json", "< 3"` | 46 runs, 0 failures [E] |

  ## Recommended order
  
  | Deploy | Contents | How far back you can roll |
  |---|---|---|
  | 0 | Section A fixes, still on 7.0.8.7 | Safe |
  | 1 | Rails 7.1.6 with the section B edits in the same commit; keep `load_defaults 7.0` | 7.0, but only by reverting the whole commit |
  | 2 | Rails 7.2.4 | 7.1 at the lowest (see C1) |
  | 3 | Rails 8.0.5.1 | 7.1 |
  | 4 | Rails 8.1.0 plus the json pin | 7.1, as long as the 8.1 `schema.rb` hasn't been committed |
  | Later | New framework defaults, one group at a time (section D) | Cache format and message serializer go last |

  ## A. Required fixes that also work on 7.0 (Deploy 0)
  
  All of these were applied together and passed on 7.0.8.7 and on every later version [E]. The combined patch is `/tmp/railsup/patches/prep-7.0-compatible.diff`; it is not applied to the repo.
  
  - **A1 – boot failure.** `config/initializers/action_text.rb:3`: from 7.1, `allowed_tags` is nil, so the app won't start. Set it in `after_initialize`, falling back to the sanitizer's default tags plus the attachment, `figure` and `figcaption` tags, then add `details summary` [E].
  - **A2 – citation settings.** `app/models/citation/provider.rb:13` reads `config/secrets.yml` through `Rails.application.secrets`. That is deprecated in 7.1 and removed in 7.2, so citation jobs would raise. Move the file to `config/citation_provider.yml`, load it with `config_for`, and update the tests in `test/controllers/citation_enrichments_controller_test.rb` [E].
  - **A3 – exports.** `app/models/export.rb:42` calls `fragments.sum`, which raises `TypeError` on every export from 7.1. Use `fragments.join` [E].
  - **A4 – imports.** `app/models/import.rb#apply` uses `return false` inside a transaction. From 7.2 that **commits instead of rolling back**, so a failed import would be left half-saved [S]. Use `raise ActiveRecord::Rollback`.
  - **A5 – import receipts.** `import.rb#receipt` reads `citation[:id]`, but citations use `doi` as the primary key. From 7.2 the receipt's DOI column would silently come out blank [S]. Use `note.citation&.doi`.

  - **A9 – notes query.** `app/controllers/notes_controller.rb` uses `where(notebooks: @notebook)`, removed in 8.0. Use `where(notebook: @notebook)` [S].
  - **A10 – routes.** `config/routes.rb` declares one route with two paths. 8.1 fails to load it, so split it into two routes, keeping the names `notes` and `journal` [E].
  - **A11 – notes search form.** `app/views/notes/index.html.erb:12` passes `form_with(model: nil)`, which raises in 8.0. Drop `model: nil` [E].
  - **A12 – import preview.** `app/views/imports/preview.html.erb` calls `.stringify_keys` on annotations. From 8.0 that **silently hides annotations** in the preview. Remove it [E].
  - **A13 – digest day (product decision).** `app/mailers/digest_mailer.rb`: from 7.1, jobs keep the reader's time zone, so the digest covers the local day instead of the UTC day the UI promises. During a mixed rollout the result depends on which version queued the job [E]. Fix by converting `requested_at` to UTC.
  - **A14 – postponed-reminder display (product decision).** `note.rb#next_day_reminder_at`: on 8.1 the time shows as `08:00-05:00` instead of `09:00-04:00`; the underlying moment is the same [E].   - **A15 – expired exports.** `app/views/exports/_export.html.erb` computes `expires_in` from the expiry time, which goes negative once an export expires. With the 7.1 defaults the exports page returns a 500 [S]. Only pass `expires_in` while the export is downloadable.

  - **B4 – json pin.** Add `gem "json", "< 3"` with the 8.1 bump. activesupport 8.1.0 calls `JSON.parse` in a way json 3.x rejects, and that breaks every session read [E]. The same call is still in 8.1.3.1 [S].

  - **C1 – DigestJob arguments.** From 7.2, its BigDecimal argument is stored in a format that **7.0 workers can't read**. Under strict `:json`, 8.1 couldn't render notes saved on 7.0 [E]. Adopt `:json_allow_marshal` only once rollback below 7.1 is ruled out. Use strict `:json` only after every rich text has been re-saved. Session cookies stayed readable in both directions [E].
  - **C4 – cache.** Production uses the default FileStore in `tmp/cache`. 7.0 raised `TypeError` on entries written in the 7.1 format [E]. Keep `cache_format_version 7.0` until the rollback window closes, or clear `tmp/cache` when rolling back.

    - To check stored data [P]: `SELECT count(*) FROM action_text_rich_texts WHERE body ~* '<(script|style|ol)'`

  - **YAML preferences:** from 7.1, values that don't start with `---` no longer pass through [S].

  Rails 8.1 warns that its built-in Sidekiq adapter goes away in 8.2, so Sidekiq 7.3.3+ will be needed before 8.2. From reading the code, that move has three hazards [S]:

  - `Notebook#request_export` passes symbol keys to `perform_async`.

I haven't changed the Rails version yet. The upgrade-gem skill only plans upgrades, so I had a planner work out the move from Rails 7.0.8.7 to 8.1.0 in throwaway copies under `/tmp/railsup`. The repo is still clean at `9938031`.

**Bottom line:** the upgrade works on Ruby 3.3.6, but not as a one-line Gemfile change. It needs about 15 code fixes and an extra Gemfile pin, `gem "json", "< 3"`. With those, all 46 tests passed on 7.0.8.7, 7.2.4, 8.0.5.1 and 8.1.0, the first three of which I checked in the logs. The planner also reports passes on 7.1.6 and passing `zeitwerk:check` runs. Without the changes, the app doesn't even start on 7.1: `config/initializers/action_text.rb:3` raises `NoMethodError`.

| Deploy | Contents | Rollback |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Section A fixes, still on 7.0.8.7 | Safe |
| 1 | Rails 7.1.6 plus the section B edits in the same commit; keep `load_defaults 7.0` | To 7.0 only by reverting the whole commit |

These are combined in `/tmp/railsup/patches/prep-7.0-compatible.diff`, which I haven't applied.

- **A3** `app/models/export.rb:42`: `fragments.sum` raises `TypeError` on every export from 7.1. Use `join`. [run]
- **A4** `app/models/import.rb#apply`: `return false` inside a transaction **commits instead of rolling back** from 7.2, so a failed import would be left half-saved. Use `raise ActiveRecord::Rollback`. [source]
- **A5** `import.rb#receipt`: from 7.2, `citation[:id]` would come out blank because citations use `doi` as the primary key. Use `note.citation&.doi`. [source]
- **A6** `app/models/note.rb:10`: the old `enum status: {...}, _prefix:` form is removed in 8.0. Change it to `enum :status, {...}, prefix: true`. [source]
- **A7** `note.rb:14`: `alias_attribute` on a `store_accessor` attribute raises from 7.2. Use two `alias_method` lines instead. [run]
- **A8** Reminder scheduling passes an Integer as `wait_until:`. Pass `Time.at(...)`. [source]
- **A9** `notes_controller.rb`: `where(notebooks: @notebook)` is removed in 8.0. Use `where(notebook: @notebook)`. [source]
- **A10** `config/routes.rb`: a route with two paths fails on 8.1. Split it into two routes, keeping the names `notes` and `journal`. [run]
- **A11** `notes/index.html.erb:12`: `form_with(model: nil)` raises on 8.0. Drop `model: nil`. [run]
- **A12** `imports/preview.html.erb`: `.stringify_keys` **silently hides annotations** on 8.0. Remove it. [run]
- **A13 (product decision)** `digest_mailer.rb`: from 7.1, jobs keep the reader's time zone, so the digest covers the local day instead of the UTC day the UI promises. The fix is to convert `requested_at` to UTC. [run]

## B. Edits that must ship in the same commit as the 7.1 bump
- **B1** `serialize :tags, JSON` and `serialize :preferences` need `coder: JSON` and `coder: YAML`. This can't go out early: **on 7.0, `coder: JSON` silently writes YAML**. [run]

## C. Rollout and rollback risks

- **C2** Job arguments that carry a time zone come back differently on 7.0 and 7.1+. A13 removes the effect. [run]
- **C3** With the 7.1 message-serializer defaults, notes saved on 7.1 didn't render on 7.0. With strict `:json`, 8.1 couldn't render notes saved on 7.0. Use `:json_allow_marshal` once rollback below 7.1 is ruled out, and strict `:json` only after every rich text has been re-saved. Session cookies stayed readable in both directions. [run]
- **C4** The FileStore cache in `tmp/cache`: 7.0 raised `TypeError` on entries written in the 7.1 format. Keep `cache_format_version 7.0`, or clear the cache when rolling back. [run]
- **C5** 8.1 rewrites `db/schema.rb` (a 72-line diff). [run] Hold that back until rollback is ruled out; the planner expects older Rails can't load it but didn't test that.
